A metal guard for the pulleys and belt to Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster.

A plug used to stopper the oil reservoir of Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster.
A cylindrical screw-in stopper for the reservoir of the TrimMaster.
A set of four wheeled feet for Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster.
A 1.5-inch diameter, 3-inch-long metal piece used to attach the Flexible Shaft to Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 Variable-Speed Motor.
An adjustable segmented white spout attached to the water source on Rhino Lapidary's 18" LapMaster.
An 8-inch-long, 1-inch diameter shaft that attaches to the left side of the Rhino Lapidary EM-1 Variable-Speed Motor.
14x13x0.25-inch plastic blue moss pad used to cover Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 left arbor floor.
A 6-inch diameter magnifying glass on a 2-foot-long arm that attaches to Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 machine.
Two 14x13x0.25-inch plastic blue moss pads used to cover Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 arbor floors.
A set of 4 cylinders used to raise the TrimMaster Plexiglass Insert using the Lock Nut Fixture for Plexiglass Insert sets.
A pack of two bearings for Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's power feed mechanism rod.
A 26" belt designed for compatibility with the Power Grip Pulleys on the TrimMaster.
A set of two pulleys to mount the belt between Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's motor and arbor.
A strand of round purple jade beads used in Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster as a measurement tool for the automatic stop mechanism of the rock saw.
An 8-inch-long, 1-inch diameter shaft that attaches to the right side of the Rhino Lapidary EM-1 Variable-Speed Motor.
14x13x0.25-inch plastic blue moss pad used to cover Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 right arbor floor.
A 10.5x9x6.5-inch blue plexiglass attachment that fits between Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 motor and the Plastic Washer to cover the Right Arbor Shaft along with any other mounted accessories.
A metal plate for holding and rotating flat lap attachments onto Rhino Lapidary's 18" LapMaster.
A pushpin component for securing Rhino Lapidary's 18" LapMaster's rotation table in place while parts are screwed on and adjusted.
The round black handle that attaches to the rotational lock for Rhino Lapidary's 18" LapMaster.
A set of three rubber feet caps for the base of Rhino Lapidary's 18" LapMaster.
A metal clamp release mechanism used to adjust Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's vice sled forwards and backwards.
A 3.5-inch diameter light attached to a 38-inch-long jointed metal arm that fits into Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 and plugs into the EM-1's electric line.
A black knob on Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's thumb spindle that is used to secure the horizontal movement of the vice sled.
A set of two screws with triangular latch heads, used for hooking either side of the workspace cover of the TrimMaster to the reservoir frame, securing the workspace during machine operation.
A metal guard for controlling lubricant spray while operating the TrimMaster saw.
This device is mounted on the left side of the work area on the TrimMaster.
A 3" tall riser for holding specimens at a higher level while using Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster.
